data.one_liner: Provides a Material‑spec responsive grid layout with columns, gutters and flexible cell spanning.
data.what_it_does: ResponsiveLayoutGrid creates a grid that adapts column count and width based on the available body width. Cells can span multiple columns, be positioned explicitly, and are separated by configurable gutters.
use_when: You need a Material‑design compliant responsive grid for complex page layouts
You want automatic column count adjustment across screen sizes
You require cells to span variable numbers of columns
avoid_when: A simple linear list or column layout suffices
Performance‑critical UI where a custom lightweight layout is needed
You need a full‑featured UI kit rather than just a grid system
strengths: Configurable column width, gutter sizes and padding
Supports explicit cell positioning and column spanning
weaknesses: Only addresses grid layout; you still need other UI components
Requires wrapping in a SingleChildScrollView for vertical scrolling

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a broader set of responsive utilities including breakpoints, scaling and layout helpers

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a simple builder pattern for responsive widgets without a full grid system

alternatives.name: sizer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight package for responsive sizing based on screen dimensions
